## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the concrete input/use case and cite the specification or independent
basis for the expected result. Link a related issue when available.

## Change

Explain the final behavior, API/diagnostic changes and any limits. For fixtures,
record provenance, encoding, hash and redistribution permission. Do not include
private or unlicensed transcript data.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, including the regression reproduction
for a behavior fix. Mark unexecuted environments as NOT RUN. Mention relevant
documentation/changelog updates. Do not infer correctness from another parser's
output alone.
